words: Which animal has grasping hands and often swings through trees?
Think of an animal that climbs using its hands and feet.
What printed paper tells us the news?
It has news stories and pictures.
Which small furry animal has webbed feet and plays and swims in rivers?
It is a furry swimmer, not a bird or a fish.
Which small round green seed grows inside a pod and can be eaten?
Think of little green balls inside a long pod.
What do you use to call someone and speak to them from far away?
You can hear someone talking through it.
What kind of animal has feathers and a beak?
Look for feathers rather than fur or scales.
What is a dome-shaped shelter built from blocks of snow?
Its walls are made from blocks of snow.
What sweet fruit spread can you put on toast?
It is made with fruit and is often kept in a jar.
Which toy flies in the wind while you hold its string?
Take this toy outside on a breezy day.
Which big wild cat can have a mane around its head?
Look for a big cat with a mane.
What device helps do work, such as printing letters on things?
It can have moving parts that help do a job.
Which insect has broad colourful wings and visits flowers?
It changes from a caterpillar into a winged insect.
What piece of cloth flies from a pole to represent a country or group?
Look for a piece of cloth attached to a flagpole.
Which juicy round food is often red and used to make ketchup?
It has soft flesh and little seeds inside.
What flat part of a plant is often green and grows from a stem?
Look at the green parts growing on a branch.
Which soft container do you use to carry things?
It can have handles or straps.
Which road vehicle has four wheels and carries a small number of people?
A family may travel in it on the road.
Which item of clothing hangs from the waist and is not divided into two legs?
It covers the lower body and starts at the waist.
Which one-piece item of clothing has a top joined to a skirt?
The top and skirt are joined together.
Friends gather to celebrate with games and decorations. What is this event?
Which black-and-white bird swims well but cannot fly?
It walks upright and uses flippers to swim.
What do we call a young male child?
Choose the word for a male child, not an adult.
What do we call a young female child?
Choose the word for a female child, not an adult.
What do you wear on your feet over socks when you go outside?
You usually wear one on each foot.
